rows.note: Use 類人猿 as the all-purpose term for a great ape or hominoid.

example.english: A gorilla is a kind of ape.
example.jyutping: daai6 sing1 sing1 hai6 jat1 zung2 leoi6 jan4 jyun4

rows.note: Use 傻 for a foolish or uncultured person, rather than specifically for an imitator.

example.english: That ape can't even do something so simple.
example.traditional: 嗰個傻仔連咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 so4 zai2 lin4 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6

rows.note: Use 學人精 for someone who foolishly copies or imitates other people.

example.english: Don't be an ape, copying everyone all the time.
example.traditional: 你唔好做學人精，成日跟住人哋學啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 hok6 jan4 zing1 seng4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 jan4 dei6 hok6 laa1
